star_examples.situation: During the H1N1 pandemic at UKHSA, there was a critical need for high-volume diagnostic throughput under CPA standards.
star_examples.task: Perform rapid, accurate RT-qPCR diagnostics and ensure laboratory staff were equipped with standardized procedures.
star_examples.action: Authored emergency SOPs for RT-qPCR workflows and trained laboratory staff on high-throughput diagnostic protocols.
star_examples.result: Ensured continuous diagnostic operations under extreme pressure with zero quality failures during the pandemic response.

star_examples.situation: A global need existed for standardized NAT (Nucleic Acid Amplification Technique) benchmarks for high-priority pathogens.
star_examples.task: Lead a global WHO international collaborative study to establish primary standards for WNV, HSV, HIV-2, and HAV.
star_examples.action: Coordinated a consortium of 32 premier institutions across 24 countries, harmonizing diverse international data into a statistically robust output.
star_examples.result: Established primary WHO International Standards that serve as the global benchmark for diagnostic accuracy. Co-authored 4 WHO Technical Reports (2017-2020).

star_examples.situation: Industrial bioprocessing required high-fidelity downstream purification and rigorous validation of chromatography systems.
star_examples.task: Manage technical execution of AKTA chromatography and Sartorius column operations within a GMP environment.
star_examples.action: Executed set-up, run, and post-run verification for AKTA systems. Managed UF/DF and VRF workflows and maintained ALCOA+ compliant batch records.
star_examples.result: Maintained 100% compliance with GMP/ALCOA+ standards, ensuring biomanufacturing batch release deadlines were met without quality deviations.

star_examples.situation: Legacy Containment Level 3 (CL3) facilities at NIBSC required refurbishment to meet SAPO4 and Schedule 5 standards without disrupting WHO production.
star_examples.task: Spearhead the refurbishment project and manage the transition while maintaining production timelines.
star_examples.action: Negotiated with facilities management, health and safety officers, and scientific stakeholders. Managed IQ/OQ/PQ qualification for all new equipment.
star_examples.result: Successfully delivered SAPO4/Schedule 5 compliant CL3 labs while maintaining all WHO production deadlines. Achieved 100% compliance for all new facilities.

star_examples.situation: The laboratory required preparation for a critical UKAS audit to maintain ISO 15189 accreditation.
star_examples.task: Lead the technical preparation and standardize blood-group testing workflows.
star_examples.action: Performed granular gap analyses on LIMS workflows and standardized ABO testing on the Immunocor Echo platform. Conducted comprehensive internal audits.
star_examples.result: Achieved zero major findings in the 2024 UKAS audit. Reduced error rates in blood-group testing by 66% through optimization.
